scheme_name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially-Abled Students (Degree)
authority: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education, Govt of India
jurisdiction: Central Government / AICTE Scheme (Disbursed via National Scholarship Portal)
benefit: ₹50,000 per annum towards tuition fee, equipment, books, stationery and assistive software

criteria.label: Candidate benchmark disability qualification (Disability >= 40%)
criteria.plain_description: Candidate must have a valid disability certificate issued by a competent government medical authority indicating at least 40% disability.
criteria.source_clause: AICTE Saksham Guidelines Clause 2.1 - Benchmark Disability
criteria.remediation: Upload valid government Disability Certificate or Unique Disability ID (UDID) card.

criteria.label: Enrolled in 1st year of AICTE approved UG Technical Degree program
criteria.plain_description: Student must be admitted to 1st year degree course in an AICTE-approved technical institution.
criteria.source_clause: AICTE Saksham Guidelines Clause 2.2 - Institutional Admission
criteria.remediation: Upload admission allotment letter or college bonafide certificate.

criteria.label: Annual family income threshold (<= ₹8,00,000 per annum)
criteria.plain_description: Total family annual income must not exceed ₹8 Lakh per year.
criteria.source_clause: AICTE Saksham Guidelines Clause 2.3 - Income Ceiling
criteria.remediation: Upload valid Income Certificate showing household income at or below ₹8 Lakh.

criteria.label: Aadhaar verified and bank account ready
criteria.plain_description: Student must possess an Aadhaar card linked with an active bank account for DBT transfer.
criteria.remediation: Upload Aadhaar card linked with bank account.

application.office_name: AICTE Student Development Cell / College Equal Opportunity Cell
documents_to_carry: Disability Certificate / UDID Card showing 40% or more disability
Admission letter issued by Centralized Counseling / College for B.Tech/B.E.
Valid Income Certificate issued by Tahsildar/SDM (income <= ₹8 Lakh)
Aadhaar Card and NPCI-seeded Bank Passbook
process_steps: Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) on the National Scholarship Portal
Choose scheme: AICTE - SAKSHAM SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME FOR SPECIALLY-ABLED (DEGREE)
Provide UDID or Disability Certificate number along with income details
Submit application for online verification by College Nodal Officer
Direct DBT grant of ₹50,000/year disbursed to verified Aadhaar-linked account
